name: schema-violation-application-type-unit-and-unit-ref
description: An application type that states its unit BOTH inline (`unit`) and by reference (`unit_ref`). Since contract `8.0.0` each reference field of an application type is exclusive with its inline form (`rule:application_types.application_type.unit-form`; `conversion-form` and `range-form` are its two siblings), and the unit named here is declared — so what refuses is the shape of the payload, not a reference.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model plus the unit `ProbeNewtonMetre`. The change set creates an application type stating a unit both ways.

authorization.notes: The scope covers every operation exactly, so the answer is the engine's and not the authorization boundary's.

input.intent: Declare the probe torque with its unit.

expected.notes: Refused when the payload is bound, at the element the payload creates. Either field alone is legal; at most one of each pair is set.
